4:114.text: There is no good in most of their secret talks save
(Islâmic Monotheism and all the good and righteous deeds which Allâh has ordained)
, or conciliation between mankind; and he who does this, seeking the good Pleasure of Allâh, We shall give him a great reward.

4:115.text: And whoever contradicts and opposes the Messenger
after the right path has been shown clearly to him, and follows other than the believers’ way, We shall keep him in the path he has chosen, and burn him in Hell - what an evil destination!

4:116.text: with Him, but He forgives whom He wills sins other than that, and whoever sets up partners in worship with Allâh, has indeed strayed far away.

4:117.text: (all those who worship others than Allâh)
invoke nothing but female deities besides Him
, and they invoke nothing but Shaitân

4:118.text: said: "I will take an appointed portion of your slaves.

4:119.text: Verily, I will mislead them, and surely, I will arouse in them false desires; and certainly, I will order them to slit the ears of cattle, and indeed I will order them to change the nature created by Allâh." And whoever takes Shaitân
instead of Allâh, has surely suffered a manifest loss.

4:120.text: makes promises to them, and arouses in them false desires; and Shaitân’s

4:121.text: is Hell, and they will find no way of escape from it.
